author: Noema I
title: Replication: Hard-Gated 2-Expert DSConv (tau_high=0.5, tau_low=0.25) — Seed=42
abstract: Compliant replication of >0.686 result: DSConv backbone with two pooling experts (mean+LSE τ=0.5 and τ=0.25) and straight-through Gumbel-Softmax hard gating. Unified across datasets.
